findings.issue: The app ships with zero tests: no test script, no runner dependency, no spec files anywhere under app/.
findings.suggestion: Add a runner (Vitest) and at minimum unit-test data.server.ts and format.ts with a stubbed fetch.

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id <= 10000 / > 10000) is duplicated across three call sites (:289, :657, :713) with no shared predicate and no tests.
findings.suggestion: Extract one isAlternateForm(id) helper and test it; use it in all three places.

findings.issue: Pagination math (page clamp, totalPages, 48-row slice) is untested; an off-by-one here reshuffles every list page.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven tests over getHomeData filters: page 1, last page, page beyond range, empty results.

findings.issue: formatHeight/formatWeight/trackable/compareText are dead code; the same math is inlined at data.server.ts:592-593 and 646-648, so the copies can diverge silently.
findings.suggestion: Delete the dead helpers or use them, and unit-test the one true implementation.

findings.issue: Sort logic (nulls last in both directions, ascending-first toggle, single aria-sort) lives inside the component and is untestable without a browser.
findings.suggestion: Extract a compareRows(rows, key, direction) pure function and test nulls-last plus direction flip directly.

findings.issue: Default game selection relies on 'last item after ascending sort by order'; refactoring the sort silently changes the default version group.
findings.suggestion: Select explicitly via Math.max on order and add a test asserting the highest-order game is default.

findings.issue: NotFound detection depends on status being attached to thrown errors and on failed promises being evicted from the cache; a refactor here turns all 404 pages into 500s.
findings.suggestion: Test apiGet error propagation and cache eviction with a stubbed fetch returning 404/500.

findings.issue: validateSearch coercion and default-omission rules are untested; regressions break deep-linkable filter URLs.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test validateSearch directly (it's already a pure function): strings, missing page, page=0/NaN/decimal.

findings.issue: Debounce effect carries an eslint-disable for exhaustive-deps and closes over search values; race behaviour on rapid filter+typing is untested.
findings.suggestion: Cover with a Playwright interaction test or restructure the debounce to use functional state updates.

findings.issue: methodSortKey's hardcoded ['level-up','machine','egg','tutor'] ordering has no test; a typo reorders move tables with no failure.
findings.suggestion: One-line unit test over the table ordering produced for a Pokémon with mixed methods.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own: no runner, no script, no spec files. All of its riskiest logic — pagination, filtering, move-table sorting, URL search handling, alternate-form exclusion, and 404 mapping — sits in a few server-side files guarded only by the externally-owned acceptance suite. A refactor of data.server.ts or the search validation would ship regressions unnoticed; the data layer is plain-function enough that a small Vitest suite with stubbed fetch would cover most of it cheaply.
